notes: sqrtRatio values are raw SqrtRatio (uint96: region<<94 | mantissa)
amounts and fees in base units as decimal strings; delta sign: positive = paid to the pool
kind: toward (uncut, uncharged) / charged (surcharge on the calculated token via accumulateAsFees right after) / bridge (one representable step onto an initialized tick, uncharged)

surcharge is a 0.64 rate; exact-in fee = computeFee(|calculated|, sur) taken from the output; exact-out fee = amountBeforeFee(inNet, sur) - inNet with inNet = in - computeFee(in, poolFee), added to the input
total = sum of Core deltas plus fees on the calculated token; anchorX16 is the anchor used by the swap (after the timestamp's update)
